name: French Knowledge Base Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed French KB recipe composite for local Wikidata entity extracts.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over task-supported local French KB resources. Wikidata provides local entity, alias, relation, canonical KB, quality, and evaluation resources for its declared extract scope.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: The exact Wikidata main structured source row is approved; the required component package carries package-local license evidence for Wikidata CC0 structured data.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: French KB component composite backed by local Wikidata core entity rows. It does not claim full Wikidata dump coverage, full named-entity-linking coverage, morphology, syntax, corpus, parallel, or full language-composite coverage.

components.reason: Default French Wikidata entity labels, aliases, relations, and ontology artifact descriptor.

notes: The required component graph provides local Wikidata French core entity rows, aliases, and relations.
Generated component reports and evaluation records are available for the required KB component graph.
